title: Magnetic or not?

predict.prompt: Which things will stick to the magnet? Tap each one to sort your guesses.

try: Tap each thing to hold the magnet to it. Does it jump and stick?
result: The iron nail, the steel paper clip and the steel food tin stuck to the magnet. The wood, the glass, the gold, the copper and the pebble did not.
why: A magnet pulls on only a few materials. Iron is one. Most steel sticks too, because steel is mostly iron, but some stainless steel, like many spoons, does not.

Most metals are not magnetic: gold, silver, copper and aluminium do not stick. A food tin is steel with a thin coat of tin, so it sticks. Recycling centres use big magnets to sort steel tins from aluminium cans.
A magnet can pull through paper, water and even your hand! Most stones do not stick, but lodestone, a stone full of the mineral magnetite, is a natural magnet.
